name: UNISA — find your qualification and entry rules (official)
notes: Every UNISA qualification has its own APS and subject rules. Step 1: open the official undergraduate qualifications list and choose your programme — https://www.unisa.ac.za/sites/corporate/default/Apply-for-admission/Undergraduate-qualifications/Qualifications/All-qualifications Step 2: use the same site to start or continue your application once you know you meet that programme’s rules. This calculator row does not check a specific UNISA APS; it is here so you always have the correct links.
